takes.name: the-header
takes.text: The lines at the top set the rules. M is the meter, three beats in every bar. L is the default length, so a plain letter lasts one beat. And K is the key, C, which means no sharps or flats.

takes.text: Each letter is a note. A capital C is middle C, and a lowercase c is the C one octave higher.

takes.name: length
takes.text: A slash cuts a note in half. So C slash is an eighth note, half a beat, and two of them fill the space of one plain C.

takes.name: the-bars
takes.text: Bar one is G for one beat, then C, D, E, F as four quick eighth notes. One beat, plus four halves, makes three. Bar two is G, C, C. Three plain letters, three beats. Bar three is the same shape as bar one, a step higher: A, then F, G, A, B. And bar four jumps up to the high c, then back down to C, C.
